events.text: Next I'm finding the test attendee on the live centre so I can start the test-run as them.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Get D1 name and job API route
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && grep -n "database_name\|^name" wrangler.toml | head; grep -n 'path.startsWith("/api/jobs\|"/api/jobs\|/api/run' src/*.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read-only lookup of test attendee row
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT id, name, email, test, revoked, substr(token,1,4) AS tk FROM attendees WHERE lower(email) LIKE '%growthcluborg%'" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]['results'])" 2>&1 | head -10

events.name: Bash
events.head: List active test attendees and their built state
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT a.id, a.name, a.email, a.test, a.revoked, (SELECT group_concat(key) FROM state s WHERE s.attendee_id=a.id) AS st FROM attendees a WHERE a.test=1 AND a.revoked=0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 15" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(r) for r in d[0]['results']]" 2>&1 | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find state table name; list active test attendees
events.input: $ grep -n "CREATE TABLE" migrations/*.sql | grep -i "state\|secret" | head; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT a.id, a.name, a.email, a.revoked FROM attendees a WHERE a.test=1 AND a.revoked=0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 15" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(r) for r in d[0]['results']]" 2>&1 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find attendees with a built funnel
events.input: $ sed -n 66,75p migrations/0002_agentic.sql; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT s.attendee_id, a.email, a.revoked, group_concat(s.key) AS keys FROM agent_state s JOIN attendees a ON a.id=s.attendee_id GROUP BY s.attendee_id HAVING keys LIKE '%funnel%' OR keys LIKE '%built%' LIMIT 15" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(r) for r in d[0]['results']]" 2>&1 | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check test identity state and test-run preconditions
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT attendee_id, group_concat(key) AS keys FROM agent_state WHERE attendee_id IN (60,122) GROUP BY attendee_id" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(r) for r in d[0]['results']]" | cut -c1-600; sed -n 663,700p ../cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | cut -c1-200
